name: Cinder-Obelisk
description: Cinder-Obelisk is a world in the middle of tearing itself apart. Three supervolcanoes ring the northern hemisphere like open throats, and at the south pole a cataclysm long ago peeled back the crust entirely, leaving the planet's incandescent core exposed to space—a second sun that never sets. Between fire and fire stretch the Glass Plains, ten thousand kilometers of fused obsidian where the ancient eruption flash-vitrified an entire continent.

The thin atmosphere is sulfur-yellow and eats unsealed metal in hours; sound carries as a low hiss, the planet's own exhalation through a thousand fumaroles. At night the core-light paints everything copper-red, and ash falls upward on thermal columns, snowing in reverse. Nothing here casts a clean shadow.

The Ferrum Combine sank forty million credits into the Deepshaft Mine before abandoning it, and nobody will say exactly why. The shaft's final survey drone transmitted footage of geometric regularities in the glass strata—walls, corners, doorways—three kilometers below where any structure should survive. The Combine sealed the elevator with a thermite charge on its way out.

Core-plasma taps around the south pole could power a fleet, which is precisely what three rival syndicates are bidding for. But salvage crews whisper that the mine was not abandoned for profit margins, and that the thermite seal has recently been breached from the inside.
